correctness.rationale: For the explicitly specified non-Fano matroid, all 29 bases satisfy basis exchange. The rank-flat classification proves the exact 20-facet presentation. Complete closure under these facets enumerates all 801 nonempty faces. Exhaustive exact rational ranks and integral Smith calculations establish smoothness of all simplicial cones, 278 singular cones and 58 maximal singular orbit closures with face types 18 tetrahedra, 24 triangles, 15 lattice parallelograms and the unique relaxed-basis fixed point. Primitive unique ray relations and saturated lattices derive 2x2, 2x3 and 3x4 rank-one determinantal transverse cones and their Segre multiplicities 2, 3, 10. The submitted standalone checker recomputes each finite step and finishes VERIFY_OK; analytic identifications follow the described toric semigroup argument. The classification is for the seven-element matroid, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural singular-stratum classification of the smallest canonical nonrepresentable-over-characteristic-two rank-three matroid obtained by relaxing a Fano circuit-hyperplane. It reveals a geometrically significant isolated singularity at the newly admissible basis, separated from 57 positive-dimensional singular components; distinguishes conifold versus non-Q-Gorenstein Segre transverse germs, multiplicities 2/3/10 and non-equidimensional disconnected singular support. Neither a routine restatement of matroid face counts nor an arbitrary numerical slice. It does not claim nongeneric singular germs or an unproved downstream application.
